title: Prove the SIGTERM flush reaches a startProcess'd orchestrator, and stop dispatch while it runs
body: The orchestrator is a sandbox.startProcess child while PID 1 (where eviction SIGTERM goes) is the sandbox control server; nothing shows the signal is forwarded, and the Workflow's killProcess ignores its signal argument. The CLI's evacuation also runs concurrently with reconciler.Supervise, which can keep dispatching or return and os.Exit mid-flush, emitting a done signal for an evicted run. ppt's AC asked for a live SIGTERM proof.
